text:
sara: Heads-up — after the midnight firewall baseline push in us-west-2, we're seeing a cascade: warm-pool GPU nodes failing join checks and KMS decrypt p99 jumped from ~140ms to >1.8s. Audit shipper backlog spiked and NAT GW egress kbps saturated.

leo: timeline? which change rolled?

sara: terraform module fw-baseline (us-west-2) was applied at 00:12 UTC. The policy tightened egress to deny-by-default and referenced a limited allowlist. Looks like the keystore VPC endpoint (10.24.8.16) was omitted from that canary.

ops-bot: Alert: warm-pool-node-loss: 97 nodes in us-west-2 in last 8m. KMS latency p95=1.2s p99=1.9s.

tasha: That keystore endpoint is on the shared-private-subnet CIDR — did the allowlist use subnet-level rules instead of endpoint-specific?

sara: yes, it used subnet-blacklist -> allowlist pattern and we accidentally allowed only specific external egress, not internal keystore endpoints.

leo: So KMS calls are timing out which blocks node bootstrap (they need keys to unseal). Nodes fail health check and are evicted, causing pressure on remaining nodes.

tasha: Immediate remediation?

sara: I added a temporary high-priority exception for 10.24.8.0/24 and restarted the warm-pool reconciler. Keystore latency recovered within ~2 minutes and nodes started rejoining. Patch id: fw-exception-332001.

ops-bot: Note: audit-shipper queue length decreased but still at 60% of capacity; S3 egress for draining estimated +$2.5k this month if we keep the backlog for >48h.

leo: Can we throttle audit-shipper writes so it doesn't saturate NAT while draining? Also consider short-term S3 lifecycle change for staging to reduce cost.

tasha: Throttling applied (shipper-qps=0.3 of prod). Lowered staging retention to 2d. Opening PR to add backpressure knobs and circuit-breaker for shipper.

security-bot: Security note: audit events delayed between 00:10-00:25 UTC for us-west-2. This is tagged as potential compliance impact. File an incident report for legal.

sara: Filed INC-2026-331 with timeline and mitigation steps.

leo: Postmortem items: 1) preflight egress check in fw CI that validates connectivity to all keystore endpoints per region; 2) add permanent keystore CIDRs to global fw baseline; 3) augment warm-pool bootstrap to tolerate short KMS hiccups with exponential backoff; 4) shipper backpressure feature; 5) add cost guardrails for large backlog drains.

tasha: I'll own 1 & 2 (security + infra coordination). sara — can you own 3?

sara: yup will start a branch. Estimating 2 days to implement and 1 day for testing.

leo: Finance: temporary NAT scale + S3 output cost ~2.5k. I pinged finance channel.

ops-bot: Deploy note: fw-baseline in us-west-2 rolled back to previous allowlist while we patch CI.

sara: Also adding a small synthetic check to the deploy pipeline that does a quick decrypt against regional keystore before applying egress rules. Example in PR.

tasha: documented runbook updates and added a playbook step: "If KMS p99 > 1s in region -> add keystore exception and throttle audit shipper".

leo: thanks. close the loop once the CI gate is live. :thumbsup:
